title: Gingersnaps
description: Barely adapted from Sweet Melissa Patisserie and Cook's Illustrated.

source.name: Smitten Kitchen (barely adapted from Sweet Melissa Patisserie and Cook's Illustrated)

items.note: finely grated, added with the wet ingredients
finely minced, added with the dry ingredients

steps: In a medium bowl, whisk the flour, baking soda, salt and spices together.
In a large bowl, beat the butter and both sugars on medium until fluffy, about 3 minutes. Beat in the egg and molasses until combined.
Add the dry ingredients and beat on low until just combined. Scrape down the bowl thoroughly so everything is evenly mixed.
Move the dough onto plastic wrap (it will be quite soft; a plate underneath helps support it). Chill in the fridge for at least 2 hours, until firm.
Heat the oven to 350°F (180°C). Roll the dough into 1-inch (2.5 cm) balls and set them at least 2 inches (5 cm) apart on greased or parchment-lined baking sheets.
Bake for 10 to 15 minutes: 10 to 12 for softer cookies, 13 to 15 for snappier ones.
Leave them on the sheets for 2 to 5 minutes, until firm enough to move to a cooling rack with a spatula. Cool completely before packing up.

notes: Unbaked dough balls keep in the freezer for up to 2 weeks; bake them as you need them.
storage: Keep in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 1 week (they soften a bit each day), or freeze for up to 1 month.
